data.name: About.Text
data.value: Opens Mac-formatted APFS disks in Windows: read-only by default, optional writing (experimental). Open source, GPLv3 license.

data.name: Card.NoVolumes
data.value: This disk has no volumes to show (only macOS internal volumes).

data.name: Disk.Gone
data.value: This disk is no longer attached.

data.name: Eject.Busy
data.value: A file on {0} is open or being copied right now ({1}). If you eject now, the copy will be cut short; your Mac disk will not be harmed.

data.name: Eject.BusyHeading
data.value: A copy seems to be in progress

data.name: Eject.Failed
data.value: The disk could not be ejected.

data.name: Eject.Remounting
data.value: {0} The disk is being mounted again.

data.name: Error.OperationFailed
data.value: The operation could not be completed.

data.name: List.NoDiskBody
data.value: Plug in your Mac disk; it appears here within a few seconds. Your disk opens read-only first; if you want to write to it, you allow that separately with the button on its card.

data.name: List.ServiceDownBody
data.value: The service that mounts the disks cannot be reached. Try restarting the computer or reinstalling the program.

data.name: List.ServiceDownHeading
data.value: The background service is not running

data.name: Main.Subtitle
data.value: Your Mac disks are safe: read-only first, writable if you choose.

data.name: Notice.CloseWriteFailed
data.value: {0}: some of the latest changes could not be written to the disk (it may have been removed). The disk will open in its previously saved state. Details: {1}

data.name: Notice.ContainerOpenFailed
data.value: {0}: the APFS container could not be opened. {1}

data.name: Notice.Detached
data.value: The volumes of {0} were unmounted. This disk does not appear as a removable device; to mount it again, use "Scan again".

data.name: Notice.Ejected
data.value: {0} was safely ejected. You can unplug the cable now.

data.name: Notice.MountedWritable
data.value: "{0}" was mounted as drive {1} WITH WRITING (experimental). Use "Safely eject" before removing the disk.

data.name: Notice.NeedsPassword
data.value: Volume "{0}" is encrypted. To open it, enter the password from the APFS icon in the notification area.

data.name: Notice.RemountedReadOnly
data.value: {0} was mounted read-only again; changes were saved.

data.name: Password.Prompt
data.value: This volume is encrypted. To open it, enter the password you use on the Mac.

data.name: Password.Reassurance
data.value: The disk is only read; the password is not saved anywhere.

data.name: Release.Changed
data.value: was changed by another program (e.g. reformatted); the APFS drive was removed

data.name: Release.SafeToRemove
data.value: was unmounted for safe removal; you can remove the disk now

data.name: Release.ServiceStopped
data.value: was unmounted because the service stopped

data.name: Release.UnsavedLost
data.value: The latest unsaved changes could not be written; the disk will open in its previously saved state.

data.name: Release.UnsavedNotWrittenChanged
data.value: The latest unsaved changes were not written, so as not to damage the new content on the disk.

data.name: Tray.StillRunning
data.value: The program keeps running in the notification area. You can reach your disks from here.

data.name: Tray.TipNoVolumes
data.value: APFS for Windows: no volumes mounted

data.name: Tray.TipServiceDown
data.value: APFS for Windows: service not running

data.name: Unlock.NotWaiting
data.value: This volume is no longer waiting for a password.

data.name: Write.AlreadyWritable
data.value: Writing is already allowed on this partition.

data.name: Write.Busy
data.value: A file on {0} is open or being copied right now ({1}). If you continue, the drive is briefly unmounted and mounted again; open files are closed.

data.name: Write.CheckFailed
data.value: The disk could not be checked: {0}

data.name: Write.ConfirmText
Write.MultipleVolumes
data.value: This partition contains more than one volume; in this version writing can only be allowed on single-volume partitions.

data.name: Write.NoSuchPartition
data.value: This disk has no such APFS partition.

data.name: Write.PreviousRequestPending
data.value: The previous request for this partition has not finished yet.

data.name: Write.RemountedReadOnly
data.value: The disk was mounted read-only again.
